name: Bulgogi Made With Kiwi Onion Sauce
instructions: Toss beef slices with 1 tbs sugar
Meanwhile prepare sauce: process onion and kiwi in blender or food processor
Add soy sauce through pepper and process briefly
Add sesame oil in a gradual stream while continuing to process
Taste and adjust seasonings: add a little more soy sauce if more saltiness is desired or more sugar for added sweetness
Toss beef with garlic , scallions and marinade , mixing thoroughly to distribute marinade evenly
Marinate , covered , in the refrigerator at least 2 hours or up to overnight
Stir-fry in skillet or wok over high heat about 2 minutes until the beef is cooked through
Place 1 / 4 of the bulgogi and 1 / 4 of the rice in each lettuce leaf and roll up
If desired , serve with dipping sauce
